description: The bar chart titled “Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments” illustrates average entropy values for three sycophancy-reduction methods across different AI models. The horizontal axis contains the categorical model names “GPT-4,” “Claude,” and “Llama” (left to right) and is labeled “Different AI Models,” while the vertical axis is labeled “Entropy Average Values” and uses a linear scale ranging from 3.0 to 6.0 with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. For each model, three adjacent (grouped) bars represent methods indicated by the legend: “Baseline” in pink, “Source Info” in pale yellow, and “Direct Command” in light blue; the bars are not stacked and appear in the same left-to-right order within each group. For GPT-4, the Baseline bar is just under 4.9 (≈4.88), Source Info is a bit above 5.2 (≈5.22), and Direct Command is just above 5.0 (≈5.03). For Claude, Baseline is around 4.67, Source Info is around 5.12, and Direct Command is around 4.93. For Llama, Baseline is around 4.55, Source Info is around 4.94, and Direct Command is around 4.80. The chart does not show explicit sorting beyond the fixed model order on the x-axis, and no bars are visually emphasized with annotations, outlines, or special shading beyond the color coding.
